g.text: Main-run predictor pretraining | P support scores and radius regression are separate from S segmentation Dice
P is selected at29k under the stated readiness/selection rule and subsequently participates in joint base training.
This figure records the initial predictor phase only. It is neither a native segmentation endpoint nor the later frozen P state.
